playdate_sdk_path.title: Playdate SDK path
playdate_sdk_path.description: Only needed if the SDK is somewhere detection does not look, or if you start your editor from a desktop launcher rather than a shell, where PLAYDATE_SDK_PATH from your profile will not be inherited. Leave empty to detect.
